text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Bosnia will have a single common curency but there will be invisible differences between bills circulating within the country's Moslem-Croat Federation and those within its Serb Republic, the daily quotes financial sources as saying.
- Bosnian foreign minister Jadranko Prlic says that the Bosnian war has had catastrophic effects on the economy and that Bosnian production losses are estimated at tens of billions of U.S. dollars.

- The European Union is going to continue working for a united Mostar, the EU administrator of the bitterly divided southern Bosnian town says in an interview published on Monday. He adds the EU has so far spent 270 million Deutsch Marks on reconstruction in the city. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
